about: Input → expected output examples for the Entry.fi liquidation risk model (romannurgaliev.com/risk-model.js). Formulas and terms: docs/risk-model.md.

conventions.mmr: not an input: maintenance margin rate = 1 / (2 × maxLev)
conventions.ratios: simulated price / mark price, per position id; prices move along a straight line from mark to mark × ratio
conventions.adjustments: fixes applied at mark prices before the move: deposit (USD), cut (share 0–1 of a position, 1 = close), sl (new stop price)
conventions.null: no value: no liquidation price, equity reserve and leverage when liquidated, and so on
conventions.riskLevel: high below 7.5% distance to liquidation, medium below 15%, low from 15%
conventions.tolerance: compare numbers with relative tolerance 1e-9 (absolute 1e-9 near zero); fix values exactly
